newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U S West Media started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U S West Media started.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Monday it initiated coverage of U S West Media Group with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of $25.
-- U S West Media Group's management is positioning the company for long-term cash flow growth and asset appreciation, ABN AMRO said.

-- The brokerage firm's bullish view is based on the existence of several events specific to the cable company that could drive its near- and intermediate-term stock performance higher than expectations for other cable stocks, ABN AMRO said. These events include completion of a merger of its wireless communications business with AirTouch Communications Inc, a restructuring of its partnership with Time Warner Inc and the expected separation from its parent U S West Communications Group in 1998, ABN AMRO said.
-- U S West Media is the nation's third-largest multiple cable systems operator.
-- Its shares were unchanged Monday at 19-1/8.
